notes: answerable: 'expected' lists the files (repo/path) that contain the answer; a hit on any of them counts.

evidence: short phrases from the actual answer text. A retrieved chunk counts at SECTION level only if it is from an expected file AND contains one of these phrases (case-insensitive). File level alone flatters retrievers that find the right README but the wrong section.
trap: nothing in Barry's public docs evidences the claim, so the assistant must say it cannot find evidence. This means 'not in the docs', not necessarily 'not true'.
